name: marco-vrinssen
description: Claude Code plugins by Marco Vrinssen.

plugins.name: video-reader
plugins.description: Reads YouTube videos through their transcript, chapters and metadata with yt-dlp, and samples still frames for on-screen content. Summarizes, answers questions and cites timestamps.

plugins.name: resume-ai-optimizer
plugins.description: Optimizes resumes for AI-screened hiring. Checks that screening software can read the PDF, maps the resume to a job description without keyword stuffing, rewrites bullets into quantified XYZ achievements without inventing facts, and shows AI skills through proof.

plugins.name: computer-checkup
plugins.description: Checks why a Mac is slow, full or at risk and fixes only what you approve. Asks which areas to cover, runs read-only checks of processes, login items, apps, storage, security and backups, reports numbered fixes and applies only the confirmed ones.
